# Employment agreement: records and equipment

**Employee:** ⟦PERSON|Jorin P. Valecroft⟧

**Employer:** ⟦ORG|Dapple Reed Analytics Ltd⟧ (the Employer)

**Staff ID:** ⟦IDENTITY|VELK-QUEN⟧

The staff ID is assigned by the employer's access system. It must be entered exactly when the employee collects equipment or submits an access request.

The employee will maintain the instrument register and prepare weekly summaries of outstanding calibration work. The employer must provide the equipment and training required for those duties. The employee is not authorised to approve an expenditure merely because it appears in a weekly summary.

The starting salary is GBP 34,200 per year. Employment begins on 7 December 2026, subject to completion of the agreed induction. The probation review will consider training needs as well as performance, and its outcome must be recorded in writing.

Company equipment remains the employer's property. The employee must report loss promptly and return the access badge when employment ends. A disputed deduction from final salary requires a written explanation of the amount and the contractual basis relied upon.

**Signature register, surname first**

Employee: ⟦PERSON|VALECROFT, Jorin P.⟧

For the employer: ⟦PERSON|Siora Dennick⟧

Signed on 29 November 2026. Section 10.2 governs the return inventory.
